concerns.text: The specification imposes a hard runtime constraint of ≤ 2 hours (FR‑010) and a lint‑warning limit of ≤ 5 (SC‑008). These engineering limits were not mentioned in the original idea and add work that does not serve the core research question of identifying predictive compositional descriptors and achieving a target R²/|r|. They constitute over‑reach beyond the idea’s scope.
